benchmark_a_fast_path.description: Fast-path RAG: normalize → guardrails → embed → retrieve → extractive → grounding_extractive. This is the <200ms SLA path.

benchmark_b_llm_enhanced.note: Skipped. Run with --mode b or --mode all

benchmark_c_voice_e2e.note: STT (Sarvam Saaras v3) is a REST network round-trip (~300-800ms typical). It is always measured and reported separately in LatencyMetrics.stt_ms. Full E2E = stt_ms + Benchmark A rag_core_ms. Not included in A or B numbers — network latency is not a property of the RAG core.
